title: Dependency Record
description: Canonical record for a dependency mention extracted from a generated response.

dependency_record_id.description: Unique identifier for this extracted dependency record.

run_id.description: Reference to the generation run from which the dependency was extracted.

dependency_name_raw.description: Original dependency string exactly as observed in the generated output.

dependency_name_normalized.description: Canonicalized dependency name after normalization, with no surrounding whitespace or quoting artifacts.

declared_version.description: Version string explicitly declared in the source artifact, if present.

source_type.description: Context in which the dependency was encountered.

source_file.description: Path or artifact identifier for the file containing the dependency reference.

source_location.description: Human-readable source location such as a line number, import statement, or package section.

is_node_builtin.description: Whether the dependency is a Node.js built-in module or standardized builtin path.

is_local_import.description: Whether the reference is relative, absolute local, or otherwise not an external package import.

extraction_timestamp_utc.description: Timestamp for the extraction event in ISO-8601 UTC format.

extractor_version.description: Version string for the extraction logic or script handling this dependency record.
